name: Avena Phase 2 By Emaar
overview: Emaar Properties' Avena 2 at The Valley is an elite residential development that features a select range of magnificent four-bedroom villas. This neighborhood seamlessly blends modern living with the tranquility of nature, making it an excellent retreat for families looking for a refined lifestyle in a peaceful setting. Located in the heart of The Valley, Avena 2 is intended to establish a harmonious community in which inhabitants may enjoy a lifestyle inspired by the UAE's natural beauty.
